name: C++/CUDA Implementation of Moment Bounds
definition: A hand-written C++/CUDA implementation of the primal (forward) and adjoint (backward) algorithms for computing moment bounds, designed to avoid the overhead of automatic differentiation (AD) graph traversal and JIT compilation limitations.
summary: A hand-written C++/CUDA implementation of primal and adjoint algorithms for moment bounds that avoids automatic differentiation overhead by generating highly optimized code through compile-time configuration.
